description: Search Twitter/X tweets by keyword, hashtag, or advanced query. Returns tweet text, author info, engagement metrics (likes, retweets, replies, views), and timestamps. 96% cheaper than official X API. Covers recent tweets.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response (for next page of results)

query.description: Search query — keywords, hashtags, or advanced operators (e.g. "AI agents", "#crypto", "from:elonmusk")

sort_order.description: Sort order: "recency" for latest first, "relevancy" for most relevant (default recency)

name: twitter.tweets.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Twitter/X Tweets
